errors.evidence: The age groups are listed on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: подредени в низходящ ред според възрастта
errors.evidence: The age groups are ordered in ascending order of age, from youngest at the top to oldest at the bottom, not descending ('низходящ').

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва проценти, вариращи от 0 до 100, с равномерни интервали от 10 единици.
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible numerical axis with tick marks or intervals. The percentage values are shown as data labels on the bar segments. The description invents a non-existent axis structure. Also, the values are on the horizontal axis, not the vertical one.

errors.text_span: За всяка възрастова група са представени четири стълба
errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart. For each age group, there is one single bar composed of four segments, not four separate bars.
The color for the category 'В много малка степен' is a shade of blue/teal, not green ('зелен цвят'). All segments are shades of blue/teal.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за всяка възрастова група са групирани един до друг
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The chart shows stacked bars, where segments are placed end-to-end within a single bar for each category, not grouped bars where bars are placed side-by-side.

errors.text_span: стълбът "До голяма степен" е с височина 67,3%
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies a segment of a stacked bar as a full bar ('стълбът') and uses the term 'височина' (height) for a horizontal bar, for which 'дължина' (length) would be more accurate.
